nav.label: Instructor panel
nav.toSign: {count, plural, one {# contract to sign} other {# contracts to sign}}

verifyBanner.label: Confirm your email
verifyBanner.text: Please confirm your email: we sent a link to {email}. Just open it, and you’re all set.
verifyBanner.textSent: We’ve just sent a new link to {email}. Please check your inbox, and the spam folder too.
verifyBanner.alreadyVerified: Your email is already confirmed. Thank you!

home.intro: Lovely to see you. Here’s what’s next for you.

toSign.title: {count, plural, one {A contract is waiting for your signature} other {# contracts are waiting for your signature}}
toSign.text: Please read it and sign it here. Your workshop opens for registration right after.

upcoming.title: Your next workshops
upcoming.emptyText: When the {brand} team plans a workshop with you, you’ll see it here.

workshops.title: My workshops
workshops.subtitle: Your upcoming and past workshops, with the people who are coming.
workshops.emptyText: When the {brand} team plans a workshop with you, you’ll see it here.

workshop.minimum: At least {min, number} needed for it to go ahead

people.title: Who’s coming ({count, number})
people.consentHelp: The camera and video marks show who agreed to appear in published photos and videos. A crossed-out mark means no: please don’t publish photos or videos where that person can be recognised.
people.summary: {photos} of {total} agreed to photos, {videos} to videos.
people.privacy: Please use these names only for this workshop, as agreed in your contract.
people.none: No one has registered yet. Names will appear here as people sign up.

contracts.title: My contracts
contracts.subtitle: Every contract we have sent you. Tap one to read it.
contracts.emptyText: When the {brand} team plans a workshop with you, its contract will be here for you to sign.

toSign.title: Please read the whole contract
toSign.text: You can sign it at the end of the page. To read it in another language, change the language at the top.

signed.title: Thank you! Your contract is signed.

workshop.open: “{title}” is now open for registration. We’ll let you know how it fills up.
workshop.confirmed: “{title}” is confirmed and will take place as planned.

signedNotice.title: You have signed this contract
signedNotice.text: Signed on {date}. You can print it or save it as a PDF.
signedNotice.otherLanguage: This is the exact text you signed, in {language}.

replaced.title: This version was replaced
replaced.text: Something about the workshop changed, so we sent you a newer version of this contract.

closed.title: This contract can no longer be signed
closed.text: The workshop isn’t waiting for a signature any more. If you have a question, please write to the {brand} team.

check.title: We can’t confirm this copy
check.text: This text doesn’t match what was recorded when the contract was signed. Please let the {brand} team know.

impersonating.title: Only the instructor can sign
impersonating.text: You’re viewing as this instructor. An e-signature must be their own, so the sign form is hidden while you’re viewing.

sign.title: Sign the contract
sign.intro: When you’ve read it all, tick the box, type your full name and press “Sign”.
sign.agree: I have read the contract and agree to it.
sign.name: Your full name
sign.nameHint: As it is written in the contract: {name}
sign.evidence: As proof, we keep the exact text with the date and time, your network address and your browser.

errors.agree: Please tick the box to say you agree.
errors.name: Please type your full name.
errors.nameMismatch: This doesn’t match the name in the contract. Please type it as written there: {name}

earnings.title: My earnings
earnings.subtitle: Your fee for each workshop, what you’ve received and what is still to come.
earnings.feeCancelled: No fee: the workshop was cancelled
earnings.advanceForCosts: {amount} of it went to workshop costs
earnings.toReturn: {amount} of the advance is to be returned to {brand}, as in your contract.
earnings.notSigned: These amounts are from the contract waiting for your signature.
earnings.estimate: This may still change: the final number of participants is set at the go / no-go decision.
earnings.footnote: The amounts come from your contract and the payments the {brand} team has recorded. Something doesn’t look right? Please write to the team.
earnings.emptyText: Your fees will appear here once you have a workshop with a contract.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: This is how visitors of the site will see you.

public.title: Public profile
public.description: Shown on the website with your workshops. English is also used on the Persian site when the Persian text is empty.

fields.photoHint: A clear, friendly photo of you. We crop it to a square.
fields.teachingFieldHint: For example: ceramics, painting, candle making.
fields.bioHint: Optional. Two or three sentences are enough.

photo.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to {size}

errors.unauthorized: You’ve been logged out. Please log in again, then try once more.
errors.storage: We couldn’t save your photo just now. Please try again in a little while.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: That’s a lot of photos in a short time. Please wait a little, then try again.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of your panel and of the emails we send you.

private.title: Private details
private.description: Only for your contracts and the {brand} team. Never shown on the site.
private.change: Need to change one of these? Please write to the {brand} team and we’ll update it for you.

approvalBanner.label: Waiting for approval
approvalBanner.text: Thank you for signing up! The team is checking your details. Once they approve your profile, we can plan workshops with you. Meanwhile you can add your photo in “My profile”.
